sentences.japanese: 君は女性の扱い方がうまい。
sentences.english: You have a way with women.
It all depends how you handle it.

sentences.japanese: 君に奴隷のような扱いをされるなんて、まっぴらだ。
sentences.english: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.

sentences.japanese: 君たちが私を扱うように私は君たちを扱うつもりだ。
sentences.english: Just as you treat me, so I will treat you.

sentences.japanese: 教授は彼女を自分の学生のように扱った。
sentences.english: The professor treated her as one of his students.
